description: Defines the RA scheduler class for handling PRACH occasions, RAR PDSCHs, and Msg3 PUSCH grants, including related functions, data structures, and configuration parameters.

classes.name: ra_scheduler
classes.description: Manages PRACH occasions, RAR PDSCHs, and Msg3 PUSCH grants, including handling indications, scheduling, and resource allocation.

methods.name: handle_rach_indication
methods.description: Enqueues RACH indication messages for processing.

methods.name: handle_crc_indication
methods.description: Handles UL CRC indications directed at Msg3 HARQ.

methods.name: run_slot
methods.description: Allocates pending RARs and Msg3s for the current slot.

methods.name: precompute_rar_fields
methods.description: Precomputes invariant fields of RAR PDUs for faster scheduling.

methods.name: precompute_msg3_pdus
methods.description: Precomputes invariant fields of Msg3 PDUs for faster scheduling.

methods.name: handle_rach_indication_impl
methods.description: Internal implementation for handling RACH indications.

methods.name: update_pending_rars
methods.description: Removes RARs outside the RAR window.

methods.name: is_slot_candidate_for_rar
methods.description: Checks if a slot is suitable for RAR scheduling.

methods.name: schedule_pending_rars
methods.description: Schedules pending RARs in a given slot.

methods.name: schedule_rar
methods.description: Allocates resources for a specific RAR and its Msg3 grants.

methods.name: fill_rar_grant
methods.description: Schedules RAR grant and associated Msg3 grants.

methods.name: get_nof_pdsch_prbs_required
methods.description: Calculates number of PDSCH PRBs needed for UL grants.
